title: Help explains the attachment content limit while a usable file is in the draft
steps: S1: mount the creation chat composer without a file and attach an accepted picture.
S2: finish the upload and send the file-only question.
S3: attach a refused file type.
expect: S1: the note is absent before attachment and visible during upload, stating that Help sees file names and types but cannot read contents.
S2: the note leaves when the draft is sent.
S3: a refused file alone does not show the note.
evidence: The composer previously showed file chips without telling the person that Help receives metadata only.
fence: The customer sees the model's attachment limit at the time the file is in the draft.

tests: the creation chat box uploads a picked file, holds Send until it is stored, then sends its id
a file the chat box cannot take is refused at once with its name, and never uploaded
